units.text: Begin with the nested layers on the left. Organization governance surrounds network routing, traffic controls, endpoint access, and identity and resource policies protecting sensitive data.
Read the upper-right panels together. Routing determines network reachability, while security groups, network ACLs, and firewalls constrain traffic at the appropriate boundaries.

Now connect the lower policy panels to the three access examples. Authorization and supported conditions can require an approved identity, resource, and endpoint path; an applicable explicit deny overrides an allow.

With the complete slide visible, network location alone is insufficient. Test intended service-to-service access and administrative access before enforcing endpoint restrictions, because an incorrect restriction can lock out legitimate requests.
